name: Hazarmaveth
overview: Hazarmaveth is a male figure mentioned in the Bible as a son of Joktan. Beyond this genealogical note, Scripture provides no additional details about his life or tribe. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical in nature.
namesAndTitles: The name Hazarmaveth means "village of Maveth." This proper name is recorded without indication that it was given directly by God, but it reflects a geographical or tribal designation associated with the individual.
familyAndRelationships: Hazarmaveth is identified as a son of Joktan, establishing his place within a specific lineage. Scripture does not record any other family relationships or descendants for him beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Hazarmaveth's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical records of Genesis, specifically as a descendant of Joktan. This lineage contributes to the biblical account of the nations and peoples descended from Noah's family, underscoring the historical and theological framework of God's providential ordering of humanity.
